dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Smithy Notice
dialogues.text: "Due to the war, the supply of Jade Steel has stagnated temporarily."

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Smithy Notice
dialogues.text: "Please wait a while longer if you have any need for Jade Steel weapon restoration or forging."

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Smithy Notice
dialogues.text: "I, Amenoma Tougo, sincerely apologize, and wish for your understanding."
